ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The picture shows a green leaf connected to the stem on the right. Label A is located near the narrower stalk-like connection between the leaf blade and the stem. Label B is located below the leaf, and a horizontal bracket spans the broad and flat green part of the leaf. Reasoning: The question asks to describe label B, so only focus on the structure indicated by B's bracket. According to the basic structure of a leaf, the broad, flat part of a leaf is called the leaf blade or leaf blade, distinguished from the petiole. Therefore B represents the leaf blade, that is, the broad part of the leaf.
